definitions.explanation: The rhythmic pattern or beat in music. Also used more broadly for timing or tempo.
Used in the pattern ～た{拍子|ひょうし}に to mean 'at the moment when' or 'just as (something happened)'.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三拍子|さんびょうし}→三拍子：22260_sanbyoushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リズム→リズム：04746_rizumu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{踊|おど}る→踊る：01250_odoru⟧。
⟦{手拍子|てびょうし}→手拍子：17763_tebyoushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{歌|うた}った→歌う：00684_utau⟧。
examples.english: I sang along to the hand clapping.

examples.japanese: {拍子|ひょうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ずれている→ずれる：03370_zureru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}がった→立ち上がる：02128_tachiagaru⟧{拍子|ひょうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ぶつけた→ぶつける：02413_butsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I bumped my head just as I stood up.

examples.japanese: ⟦くしゃみ→くしゃみ：04428_kushami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{拍子|ひょうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{痛|いた}めた→痛める：13613_itameru⟧。
examples.english: I hurt my back at the moment I sneezed.
Just as I opened the door, the papers blew away in the wind.

notes:
{拍子|ひょうし} has both a musical meaning (rhythm/beat) and a temporal meaning (the moment when something happens).

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{三拍子|さんびょうし}→三拍子：22260_sanbyoushi⟧: triple time; also used in ⟦{三拍子|さんびょうし}→三拍子：22260_sanbyoushi⟧⟦{揃|そろ}う→揃う：01953_sorou⟧ (to have all three desirable qualities)
- ⟦{手拍子|てびょうし}→手拍子：17763_tebyoushi⟧: hand clapping to a rhythm
- ⟦{拍子抜|ひょうしぬ}け→拍子抜け：17589_hyoushinuke⟧: anticlimax, letdown

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～た{拍子|ひょうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: at the moment when, just as
  This pattern describes something unexpected happening simultaneously with an action.
